ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a transformer, and the two ends of the secondary winding are labeled with the voltage U2; the secondary output is connected to the diamond-shaped rectifier bridge on the right side, after the rectifier bridge a load resistor RL is connected, the two ends of the load are labeled with the output DC voltage uL, and the polarity of positive on top and negative on bottom is marked. method.method_draft: From the image, model the secondary voltage as \(u_2(t)=U_m\sin\omega t\) and the bridge output as \(u_L(t)=|u_2(t)|\). From the text, set \(U_m=\sqrt2\cdot20\text{ V}\). Average over one period: \(\bar u_L=\frac{1}{2\pi}\int_0^{2\pi}|U_m\sin\theta|d\theta=\frac{2U_m}{\pi}=\frac{2\sqrt2}{\pi}\cdot20\approx18\text{ V}\).
